_comment: Script for preview/record_screencast.py and the in-app ScreencastDirector.
The runner reads login/lobby/game/recording/startStyle, the client reads
clock/timeline/cueSheet from the very same file.
Copy this to screencast.json (which is git-ignored) and put the real
credentials in there - do not commit them.
User name and password are written into config.xml before the start, so
the login form comes prefilled and three times Return logs in. Nothing
is typed on camera - use --type-credentials if the prefill ever fails.
gameListFilter ranking = the lobby filter 'open, not full, ranking game'.
gameRowIndex is how many times Down is pressed in the game list before
Return joins - 0 takes the first row.
The playing mode the runner switches to once the first hand is dealt:
autoCheckFold (F7) checks when the check is really free and folds
otherwise - no raises, no expensive calls. autoCheckCall (F8) calls any
amount, manual (F6) leaves every turn to the timer, off presses nothing.

recording._comment: How long the recording keeps running after the first hand was dealt.

_comment_startStyle: The look the recording opens with. It is written into config.xml before the
start, so the first frame is already the intended one - the timeline then
_comment_timeline: at = seconds after the clock anchor (here: the first dealt hand).
atHand = alternatively, from this hand number on.
Fields that are left out stay untouched, so a cue can change the deck alone.
reaction + visible:true opens the real reaction picker on camera; without
visible the emoji goes out silently and only the effect above the seat shows.
marker = a pure post production mark, it changes nothing in the client.
